visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing an olive-green button-down short-sleeved shirt and a black backpack, stands in a brightly lit indoor corridor with white walls. He speaks energetically to the camera, using varied facial expressions and looking directly into the lens. (2) In a spacious airport baggage claim area, multiple suitcases in various colors like silver, red, and black rotate on a black mechanical carousel belt. The man enters the frame, walks alongside the moving belt, and identifies a large black suitcase. He lifts the heavy suitcase with one hand, showing a sleeve tattoo on his left arm, and smiles at his find. (3) Detailed close-up shots showcase a black suitcase with bold, vertical white text reading 'BENWOOOO'. The camera pans over the textured surface, highlighting the 'CASETIFY' logo on the reinforced corners and the 'Hinomoto' branding on the rotating wheels. A hand demonstrates the TSA lock mechanism and the internal storage space, which is filled with packaged toys and a tote bag. (4) The man is shown in various outdoor locations: walking along a paved coastal path with a white lighthouse and rocky cliffs in the background under a cloudy sky, strolling through a busy urban street with palm trees and colorful shop signs, and placing the suitcase into the trunk of a white car. (5) A close-up shot features a matching black phone case with white text held up against a beach backdrop. The final sequence shows a serene ocean view and an underwater shot of the seabed with small corals and pebbles.

(2) A mechanical whirring sound of a luggage carousel is briefly audible under the narration. A sharp 'clack' SFX emphasizes the man picking up a suitcase. The speech rate is brisk and clear, focusing on product branding. (3) As the man details features, various post-production SFX like 'dings' and 'pop' sounds are triggered to highlight technical specifications. The BGM remains steady with a strong rhythmic pulse. (4) In outdoor scenes, faint ambient wind noise and soft splashing sounds are layered subtly beneath the energetic narration. The male voice maintains a high pitch variability, expressing excitement about the scenery and the product's performance. (5) The video concludes with the BGM swelling slightly in volume as the voice offers a final recommendation, followed by a soft musical fade-out.
